name: PetraPMS
problem: Reservations, room status and guest bills live in one system, so the front desk is not reconciling registers, spreadsheets and paper folios at checkout.
description: Hotel and resort operations software for reservations, guest records, room inventory, housekeeping status, billing, check-in and check-out.

name: PetraPOS
problem: Orders, kitchen tickets and payments run as one flow, so an outlet closes the day with sales and stock figures it can reconcile.
description: Point of sale for restaurants, cafés and room service: order handling, kitchen tickets, billing, stock control and sales reporting.

name: PetraDMS
problem: Purchases, stock, sales, customer dues and collections share one ledger, so a distributor always knows what is on the shelf and who still owes money.
description: Distribution operations from one desk: sales and invoicing, purchasing, multi-unit stock, customer and supplier ledgers, expenses and daily-to-monthly reports.
